Name: Mine Tweaks
Author: Shockah
Description:
[size=6]TL;DR:[/size]
[size=4]Tweaks for various things in the mines.[/size]

Allows tweaking the chance to get stones, gem stones, items (forage-like minerals) and monsters in any mine. Additionally allows tweaking the extra monster chance granted by using the Monster Musk.

[size=6]Other info[/size]
You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/Shockah/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/master/MineTweaks]here[/url].
